text:
Type: textured dark grey throw blanket
Use: covering the legs on a sofa or armchair, draping over a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: soft woven fabric with a nubby pebbled weave, contrasting border band
Colors: charcoal grey, black, dark grey
Shape: folded rectangle with a dense pebbled texture, black band along the edges, soft heavy drape, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, warm, understated, soft
Goes with: grey or black sofas, wool, leather, light wood; contemporary, Scandinavian or minimalist living rooms
